reason: The v3 single_storey run accepted A-D but E returned two incomplete responses under DeepSeek's default thinking mode and max_tokens=16000. This separate batch explicitly sets thinking.type=disabled. Cases, skills, per-call token cap, all other limits and success criteria are held constant. Earlier failed runs and the diagnostic remain recorded separately.
scope: Existing 0.1.0 fixed A-F building-oriented pipeline only; later natural, editing and target-adapter batches are separate.
sample_policy: One run per case. Every started v4 run remains in the v4 denominator, including API, schema, geometry, budget and export failures. Earlier batches and the one-request diagnostic are never overwritten or counted as v4 samples.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces the package and target hashes.
success.human: Record requirement coverage, spatial layout, style, visible target usability and every manual correction for each successful sample; missing evidence is unverified rather than pass.
success.batch: Report completed cases out of all four, first-attempt success, rejections by category, retries, wall time and provider-reported tokens. Four of four machine successes are required to call v4 machine passed; this small sample does not establish a population success rate.

cases.prompt: 在一块32米见方的平坦区域内，沿一条可步行的街道建造一栋单层木屋。木屋需要一个面向街道的入口和一间能够从街道进入的室内房间。
在一块32米见方的街区内建造一栋两层木构商铺。一层是沿街商店，二层是一间居室；从街道进入商店后，应能沿楼梯连续到达二层居室。
在一块48米见方的平坦街区内建造一间单层商铺和一栋单层住宅。两栋建筑分开布置，各自有入口，街道应连接两处入口，留下可辨认的公共空地。
在一块32米见方的缓坡地形上建造一栋单层小屋和一条连接其入口的道路。地面需有可辨认的高差；小屋必须稳定落地，入口和道路应在该高差下保持可通行。
